youtube_title: Woke Up With A Stiff Neck? Don't Keep It Still | Body Fix #50 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #50. Woke up and your neck won't TURN? Robot mode?
B is right. Gentle movement + warmth. Keeping it totally still makes it stiffer.
Usually an awkward sleep position or a pillow too high or flat. Better in days.
Fix: Slow neck turns, no force, warm compress, one firm low pillow, phone at eye level.
Red flags: Fever + headache + stiff neck, after an injury, or arm numbness? DOCTOR now.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Neck pain
